verdict.rationale: Wise documents global account details for receiving payments in 40+ currencies, and community reports confirm Wise Business users hold USD account details, so viewing account numbers is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows a bank verification letter, and balance statements are a different feature, so they do not count. Community reports of account details changing with zero-day notice are a reliability concern, not evidence that users cannot view them. missing for 10: bank verification letter generation, explicit documentation of viewing routing numbers in the dashboard, self-service anytime access to those documents.
